title: Skill text: record-page rule still teaches the removed stage path and key-field strip (highlightFields / stageField) after #35891
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Found by the L1 review of PR #35938 (#35891 + #35849). Part of epic #35590 (record page redo). This card belongs on a `domain:skills` PR, because `skills/**` edits are not made on a `domain:ui` PR.

## Gap
Step 1 of `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/record-page.md` still says that `highlightFields` draws the key-field strip and that `stageField` draws the stage path. Per the 11-20 fig. 41 direction on #35590 ("remove the stage bar and the key-field strip"), PR #35938 takes both off the record page. An AI build that follows the rule would still declare them and expect them to render.

## To do
Once #35938 merges, rewrite that step to match the shipped page: say what `highlightFields` and `stageField` drive now, or that they no longer draw anything on the record page, with a minimal example. Re-measure the skill ratchet in the same PR.

## Acceptance
- The record-page rule no longer describes a strip or a stage path that the page doesn't draw.
- The skill gates stay green, with the ratchet re-measured.

Reader: `domain:skills`.
